planets.name: TOI-260 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-260 with a 13.5-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-260 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-260. Its orbit and size follow Hobson et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
